newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's POSCO confirms steel price cut.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's POSCO confirms steel price cut.

text.p: South Korea's Pohang Iron and Steel Co (POSCO) confirmed a finance ministry report on Wednesday that it will cut domestic prices for hot coil steel from late October.

But Park In-suh, a manager at POSCO's hot coil sales division, said the price reduction would only apply to steel produced from the company's new electric-powered furnace, which is still in test operation.
Output from that furnace will account for 15 percent of POSCO's total hot coil production in 1997, Park said. The rest will come from blast furnaces.
